description: A number passes term recognition at context size \(n\) exactly when it codes a term with original free names, auxiliary names and the allowed scoped slots.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.mixed_term_recognition_iff.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) (n e : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.isTerm S n e = true ↔
    ∃ t,
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.termCode S
          (Sum.elim
            (Sum.elim Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.freeName
              Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.auxName)
            fun j => Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.boundName ↑j)
          t =
        e
